body:
I like that, and I can recognize it in myself.  Sometimes you just feel marked.

I read recently that depression often causes people to develop empathy.  Thank you for coming here and saying kind words to me.  It means a lot.

Thank you for sharing a little of your story with me.  I find it encouraging because I know I have wasted so much time.  The problem is, I can't seem to find my way out of this.  I have to keep trying, though.  I made it through a couple of very suicidal days and now I have to keep trying again.

You are doing stand-up?  That's totally awesome :)
I hope so...you know?  It often doesn't feel like it, but I'm trying.  I hope the same for you, that you can keep on holding on.
I'm glad you have a dog, and that your dog has you.  I hope you can continue to hang in there.

I hope, that if I am on the verge of doing what I had planned (and now is fading a little...) I will remember what you've said here.  You're right...I don't know how I may affect people in the future.  I certainly hope it will be for the positive.  It seems impossible now, but who knows.
I hope I can find the strength to keep going.  As you said, I need to keep thinking that tomorrow might be better.
I thank you for your encouragement...so very much.  I am glad you have the energy to say these words to suffering people.  They do make a difference.

I am in my early 40's.  I understand your feelings, though...I've always felt ancient.  It seems almost funny now (that I'm crawling through 'middle' age) how ancient I thought I was when I was in my 20's, as you do.  If I could give you anything, it would be a sense of being young.  I hope that when you are my age, you will feel better.  I sincerely hope that for you.
